purpose: Teach: ディベート/主体性/スパン/税額/キャスティング/特技/創意/突出

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学会で、本気で、絶対、ディベート、絶対、参加してきたか、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — did you attend the conference debate seriously? I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Direct authority without harshness. Lean forward slightly. Measured pace. Eyes steady and expecting an honest answer, not reassurance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究に、本気で、絶対、主体性、絶対、もって、絶対、取り組んでおります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm approaching my research with genuine commitment and care. Thank you for believing in me.
lines.style: Earnest and grounded. Steady voice. No over-performance. The quiet seriousness of someone who means what he says and knows the weight of being taken seriously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文の、本気で、絶対、スパン、絶対、計画を、絶対、立てておけ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Set up a realistic timeline for your paper. Get it done.
lines.style: Brief, assured delivery. No filler. The confidence of someone who has seen papers through to completion before. Expectation embedded, not request.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の税額、本気で、絶対、控除、絶対、確認、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'll verify the research grant deductions and tax documentation. Thank you for the guidance.
lines.style: Careful and methodical. Slight pause before key words — showing he's thinking through each step. Respectful but not servile. The voice of someone taking notes mentally.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: プロモビデオの、本気で、絶対、キャスティング、絶対、研究室、絶対、議論しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Discuss the casting for the promotional video with your lab. Work it out together.
lines.style: Calm instruction. Not rushing. Gives the direction, then lets the silence sit — trusting Ren to understand the implication that collaboration matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。私の特技、本気で、絶対、データ分析、絶対、なんです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Data analysis is my strongest skill — I'll put that to good use. Thank you.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. No apologizing for strength. Direct and honest. A small lift on the final phrase — genuine gratitude, not obligatory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文に、本気で、絶対、創意、絶対、込めて、絶対、書け、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Put real originality into the paper. Make it stand out.
lines.style: Firm but not cold. Weight on 'originality.' The voice of a mentor who doesn't settle for competent. Breath held slightly at the end — waiting for understanding to land.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で、本気で、絶対、突出した、絶対、評価、絶対、目指してまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'll work toward making an outstanding impression at the conference. Thank you for everything.
lines.style: Closing note of sincere resolve. Slightly softer than before — end of conversation. Slow enough to be meaningful. The finality of a promise made to someone whose opinion matters.
